prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1142; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle drifted into their lane on the highway. Insured vehicle sustained damage to the rear quarter panel and driver side mirror. No police report filed at scene; both drivers exchanged information. Claimant contacted the office by phone and confirmed she is not represented by an attorney. Initial coverage review in progress.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from the insured driver. Insured states the other vehicle signaled but moved over before the signal was complete. Insured braked and steered right to reduce impact. Insured reports immediate neck stiffness and lower back soreness, and states they sought same-day evaluation at an urgent care facility. Photos of both vehicles uploaded to the file. Liability appears disputed at this stage.

Entry 3: Claimant reached by phone for injury update. Claimant reports ongoing neck pain rated as moderate, with stiffness when turning the head and lower back discomfort after sitting for long periods. Claimant has not yet returned for follow-up care. Advised claimant of the right to seek a repair estimate and to keep all treatment records. Claimant asked general questions about the claims process and was provided the standard information packet.

Entry 4: Medical records received from the urgent care provider. Diagnosis listed as cervical and lumbar strain, with a recommendation for physical therapy and over-the-counter pain relief. Records reviewed and added to the claim file. Follow-up with claimant scheduled to confirm whether physical therapy has begun. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect current injury information.

Entry 5: Claimant confirmed she has started a course of physical therapy and expects to continue for several weeks. Repair estimate for the claimant's vehicle reviewed against the damage photos and found consistent with reported impact. Other driver's insurer contacted to discuss liability allocation; response pending. Claim remains open. Next review scheduled once therapy progress notes are received.
